sentences: The selected question asks for an explicit Boolean function family that defeats circuits of mildly superlinear size and polynomially bounded depth.
The circuit gates have constant fan-in and fan-out, and the target fixes positive exponents for both resource bounds.
The source raises this circuit lower-bound problem as a barrier to proving stronger distributed graph-detection lower bounds.
It shows that certain polynomial CONGEST lower bounds for ordered paths or induced cycles would already solve the circuit challenge.
The connection warns that apparently local network problems can require progress on a major unrestricted circuit lower-bound frontier.
